integrity: The proof is exact and self-contained once standard trace-class duality and positive/negative decomposition are fixed. No numerical experiment, finite-dimensional extrapolation, or inaccessible premise is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the trace metric and the translated Wigner family; it does not classify all nonstandard approximate isometries or assert an analogous Bures formula.
The originality comparison cannot exclude an older equivalent observation formulated as a general positive-cone translation lemma.
title: Exact covering radius and Wigner defect of translated positive trace-class cones
